## Summary

Honeywell is a US industrial conglomerate founded in 1906 by Mark Honeywell in Wabash, Indiana, headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, operating in building automation, industrial automation and energy and sustainability, with aerospace, safety and productivity (including scanning and mobility) and performance materials groups [5]. It spun off its consumer products business as Resideo in 2018, announced in February 2025 a split into three companies, separated Solstice Advanced Materials in October 2025 and Honeywell Aerospace in June 2026 [5]. The IEEE registry lists blocks under "Honeywell" at US addresses in Fort Washington, Pittsford, Minneapolis, Fort Mill and Clearwater, Florida (one marked Aerospace), under "Honeywell International" at Poway, California, and under "Honeywell International Inc" at North Vancouver, Canada [1][2][3][4].

A MAC in these blocks is most likely industrial, building or aerospace equipment rather than a consumer device, since the consumer business left with Resideo [5]; which products carry them is not documented by the sources consulted, so radios and silicon are empty. NVD records CVE-2023-5389 against the Experion ControlEdge UOC and VirtualUOC controllers [6]. FCC grantee codes are not listed because the FCC ID databases refused access from the session that wrote this entry, and randomization is unknown.
